ambiguities.text: A 'breaking change to this functionality is likely to come in the future' - no specifics on what will change
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume potential changes include: removal of code deletion, modification of balance transfer semantics, or complete opcode removal. Developers should not rely on any current SELFDESTRUCT behavior.

ambiguities.text: No timeline or conditions specified for when the breaking change will occur
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Treat as indefinite future change. Developers should design new contracts without SELFDESTRUCT dependency regardless of timeline.

ambiguities.text: 'Non-normative text' update - unclear if any normative behavior is actually changed by this EIP
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Confirm that EIP-6049 itself makes no protocol changes. It is purely advisory, signaling future intent to modify SELFDESTRUCT.

implicit_assumptions.description: Developers will read and heed deprecation warnings in the Yellow Paper
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: New contracts may continue to be deployed with SELFDESTRUCT dependencies, increasing future breakage risk

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethereum community has consensus that SELFDESTRUCT should be changed in the future
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If consensus changes, the deprecation notice may cause unnecessary developer concern

implicit_assumptions.description: Future breaking changes to SELFDESTRUCT will be communicated with sufficient advance notice
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Abrupt changes could break deployed contracts with inadequate time for mitigation

implicit_assumptions.description: Alternative patterns exist for use cases currently served by SELFDESTRUCT
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Some legitimate use cases may become impossible if SELFDESTRUCT is removed without alternatives
